deadline.value: Applications for funding sources close on 28 January, with the 2026 date shown, so 2027 is inferred. Self-funded applications are accepted all year.
deadline.quote: the application deadline is 28 January 2026 for September 2026 entry

also.quote: We welcome applications from self-funded students throughout the year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject requirement is mentioned on the pages checked.

supervisor.value: You must identify a potential supervisor and contact them first. Once they agree to consider your application, you apply formally.
supervisor.quote: Before applying, you should identify a potential supervisor for your PhD. | Once you have contacted a potential supervisor, and they have agreed to consider your application further, you will be required to make a formal application.

funding.value: Some funded PhD projects are advertised; applicants may also self-fund at any time of year.
funding.quote: We have some funded PhD projects which are advertised on our PhD Projects page.

also.quote: Applications from candidates intending to self-fund their PhD are also accepted all year round.

entry_route.value: A first or good upper second-class honours BSc in mathematics or statistics is normal, or a more advanced qualification such as an MSci, MMath or MSc.
entry_route.quote: Candidates for the PhD programmes in Mathematics or Statistics should normally have a first or good upper second-class honours BSc in mathematics or statistics, or a more advanced qualification such as MSci, MMath, or MSc.

ielts_min.value: The School of Mathematical Sciences states IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in all categories.
ielts_min.quote: Academic IELTS: 6.5 overall, with a 6.0 in all categories.

notes: Own programme code (Statistics). Deadline and funding rules are the School of Mathematical Sciences rules.
